s.note: the baked potatoes crafted in the Overworld
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Prick 4 large potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake directly on the rack for 60 to 70 minutes until crisp outside and soft inside. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Split the potatoes, fluff the insides with a fork and add 15g butter each. Top with 120g grated cheddar and return to the oven for 5 minutes. Finish with bacon, 150g sour cream and chives.

Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 200g flour, 1/2 tsp bicarb and 150g chocolate chips. Press into a lined 20cm square tin and bake at 175C for 22 minutes. Cut into neat squares while warm.

m.note: the chicken jockey, a moment everyone remembers
m.how: Toss 12 chicken drumsticks with 4 tbsp honey, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 45 minutes, turning and basting twice, until sticky and charred at the edges.

w.how: Roast 600g pumpkin until soft and purée. Whisk with 395g condensed milk, 2 eggs, 2 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of nutmeg. Pour into a blind-baked shortcrust case and bake at 180C for 45 minutes until just set. Cool and serve with 200ml whipped cream.

d.how: Drizzle chocolate syrup inside 4 tall glasses. Blend 500g chocolate ice cream, 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 2 tbsp chocolate syrup until thick and smooth. Pour into the glasses. Roughly crush 80g chocolate malt balls in a bag with a rolling pin and scatter over the top. Serve with straws.
